originalName: Sweet Cake ("Rodon Kuchen"), No. 90; index: Napfkuchen ("Rodon-Kuchen")

source.author: Henriette Davidis
source.title: A Practical Book of the Art of Cooking as Performed in Germany (Milwaukee, Wis.: C. N. Caspar Co., Book Emporium)
source.place: Division S (Pastry, Cakes, Etc.), No. 90; the rising as given under No. 1 (General Directions)

pound.read: The source is an American edition (title page: "Compiled and adapted for the United States, according to the Thirty-fifth German Original, with Weights and Measures in American equivalents"; preface: the German metrical measures "have been changed to conform to those in vogue" in the United States); taken as the US customary (avoirdupois) pound of units.json (453.59237 g). A judgement.

cupful.read: The source is an American edition (title page: "Compiled and adapted for the United States, according to the Thirty-fifth German Original, with Weights and Measures in American equivalents"); taken as the US customary cup of units.json (236.5882365 ml). A judgement.

teaspoonful.read: The source is an American edition (title page: "Compiled and adapted for the United States, according to the Thirty-fifth German Original, with Weights and Measures in American equivalents"); taken as the US customary teaspoon of units.json, one third of a tablespoon (4.92892159375 ml). A judgement.

sourceNote.en: The source reads "% pound of freshened butter". The fraction is not legible in either text, so no amount is given.
sourceNote.de: Die Quelle nennt "% Pfund frisch gemachte Butter". Der Bruch ist in beiden Texten nicht lesbar, daher keine Menge.

sourceNote.en: The source reads "% pound". The fraction is not legible in either text (the German edition's "4 Pfd." is not one half), so no amount is given.
sourceNote.de: Die Quelle nennt "% Pfund". Der Bruch ist in keinem der beiden Texte lesbar (die deutsche Ausgabe nennt "4 Pfd."), daher keine Menge.

sourceNote.en: The source reads "% pound of sugar"; the fraction is not legible in either text, so no amount is given.
sourceNote.de: Die Quelle nennt "% Pfund Zucker"; der Bruch ist in keinem der beiden Texte lesbar, daher keine Menge.

sourceNote.en: The German edition's quantity is not clearly legible ("d Dt."). The source's 1 cupful stands.
sourceNote.de: Die Menge der deutschen Ausgabe ist nicht eindeutig lesbar ("d Dt."). Es gilt die 1 Tasse der Quelle.

sourceNote.en: Read as one half: the English text shows a damaged fraction ("%"), the German edition shows one half ("½ Theelöffel").
sourceNote.de: Als ein halber Teelöffel gelesen: der englische Text zeigt einen verstümmelten Bruch, die deutsche Ausgabe ½ Theelöffel.

note.en: The yeast is dissolved before it goes into the dough.
note.de: Die Hefe wird vor dem Einrühren aufgelöst.

note.en: To sprinkle into the buttered pan.

text.en: Stir the butter to a cream.
Add the eggs little by little, stirring constantly.
text.de: Die Eier nach und nach unter ständigem Rühren zugeben.

text.en: Stir in the almonds, the milk, the lemon peel, the salt, the sugar and the dissolved yeast.
text.de: Mandeln, Milch, Zitronenschale, Salz, Zucker und die gelöste Hefe einrühren.

text.en: Stir in the flour a spoonful at a time.
Butter a pan and sprinkle it with the grated roll.
text.de: Eine Form buttern und mit dem geriebenen Brötchen ausstreuen.

text.en: Put the dough into the pan, cover it and let it rise in a warm place without a draught.
text.de: Den Teig in die Form geben, zudecken und an einem warmen, zugfreien Ort gehen lassen.

settled.reason: Our judgement: the source names no number of persons; the recipe is for 1 pound of flour and 9 eggs, one cake.

check.note: Second check (second agent) against the German edition, Nr. 103 (davidis.txt 41356-41367); rising as Nr. 1 (41345: 1 1/2 h), English General Directions 24714-24731. Agreed: 1 pound flour, 9 eggs, 1 cupful warm milk, lemon, steps. Salt one half (German 1/2 Teeloeffel). Rising 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Removed, not legible in either text: butter, almonds, sugar. Milk number not clearly legible in German; English kept. German 1 Unze yeast not taken over. 3 of 7 main ingredients keep an amount.

note.en: The English edition's Sweet Cake, which its index names as the Napfkuchen. The text says to bake it in a buttered pan, not a mould. The source's remark that baking powder can replace the yeast is not transcribed. The German version with 15 eggs and citron is not in the English text and is not used.
note.de: Der Süße Kuchen der englischen Ausgabe, den deren Register als Napfkuchen führt. Der Text sagt, in einer gefetteten Form zu backen, nicht in einer Napfform. Der Hinweis, Backpulver statt Hefe zu nehmen, ist nicht übertragen. Die deutsche Fassung mit 15 Eiern und Zitronat steht nicht im englischen Text und wird nicht verwendet.
